narrative: The new book lies open at the second book. His left finger holds a place. No stanza is copied onto a sheet. The heavy chronicle lies open beside it. His right finger keeps a page. The cat is shifted to the outer margin and is not off the book.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read with a finger in each, and copied nothing.
